commands_used: answer 1. I work for Never-Writes-Twice, who sent me to collect three seal-stones that open the Kings Gate to the Root, where the Eye of Argonia can heal sick Hist trees. The first stone is a dead thief stone in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison, held by the Blackguards heirs, who kill strangers. 2. Get into Blackrose Prison past the gate-captain Corvus Ulvius, then reach the warden vault in Raj-Kaal Hall, where raj-kaal Okaz-Teel keeps the key on his belt. 3. Pay 300 gold toll, persuade him with words, duel him, sneak over the walls, or use force. Also an Imperial in the hall has a buyer for the vault contents, so he is a rival. 4. I do not understand exactly what the Root and Eye are, or who the Collector is. I could learn by talking to people and reading.

answer 1. Words worked: Corvus let me in as a guest and the heirs are friendly. I still work for Never-Writes-Twice to get the seal-stone from the Warden Vault. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is in the hall as a guest and wants the vault contents too. 2. Go into Raj-Kaal Hall and get the stone from the Warden Vault. 3. Buy the key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold, pickpocket it from his belt, or pick the vault lock at night; a seen theft turns the garrison on me. The Collectors Kothringi silver ring helps thieves, and he may be a rival or ally. 4. I do not know what the Root and Eye truly are, or whether the Collector is friend or foe; I could talk to him and Okaz-Teel.

answer 1. I paid Okaz-Teel 1000 gold and got the vault key and, he says, the contents. I still work for Never-Writes-Twice collecting seal-stones for the Kings Gate. 2. Go through the Warden Vault door in this hall and take the seal-stone from the Warden Chest. 3. Just unlock the vault with the key; the Collector Ennodius Vanin is nearby and I could talk to him. 4. Still unknown: what the Root and Eye truly are and the Collectors purpose; I could ask him.

answer 1. I now hold the first Seal-Stone of the Kings, bought via the vault key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold. I work for Never-Writes-Twice; three stones open the Kings Gate to the Root. 2. Take the other two stones: Gemin (flooded vaults) and Vorannuhl (deepest hall); both are marked. 3. Go to either one first; Gemin is likely easier than Vorannuhl, and I may need waterbreathing for Gemin. 4. Still unknown: what the Root and Eye truly are, who the Collector is beyond Ennodius Vanin wanting vault goods, and what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar.

answer Notes: I got into Blackrose Prison by persuading gate-captain Corvus Ulvius (Speech check passed), then bought the warden vault key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold and took the Seal-Stone of the Kings from the Warden Chest. I have about 350 gold left, the rapier, lockpicks, 3 Grey Seals, 3 Unbound Seals, the Recipe for the Seal, the Pale Harvest key, disc, keystone, eye-setting, Reel-Ka cuirass and helm, the Warden Vault Key and now one seal-stone. Two stones remain: Gemin (flooded vaults, may need waterbreathing) and Vorannuhl (deepest hall, hardest); markers are set. Ennodius Vanin, the Imperial Collector, was in the hall at Blackrose, wanting the vault goods; I did not talk to him. Still unknown: what the Root and Eye truly are, the Collectors aims, and what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar. Then take all three stones to the Kings Gate at Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth, guarded by the ghost of Sul-Xeeth.
